description: This file defines the RegistryMap class which manages provider registry information, including credentials, available providers, models, and schema merging for a provider registry system. It interacts with fetcher models, registry data, and handles schema validation and extraction.

classes.name: RegistryMap
classes.description: Class to store and manage provider registry information, including credentials, available providers, models, and schema merging.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RegistryMap instance, loading registry data and preparing models and credentials.

methods.name: registry
methods.description: Property to access the registry object.

methods.name: available_providers
methods.description: Property to get the list of available provider names.

methods.name: credentials
methods.description: Property to get the mapping of providers to their credentials.

methods.name: standard_extra
methods.description: Property to get the standard extra map for query and data schemas.

methods.name: original_models
methods.description: Property to get the original models map.

methods.name: models
methods.description: Property to get the list of available models.

methods.name: _get_credentials
methods.description: Retrieves a map of provider names to their credentials from the registry.

methods.name: _get_available_providers
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of provider names.

methods.name: _get_maps
methods.description: Generates maps for provider schemas and models from the registry.

methods.name: _update_json_schema_extra
methods.description: Merges JSON schema extra information for different providers.

methods.name: _get_models
methods.description: Returns a list of model names from the map.

methods.name: _get_results_type
methods.description: Extracts the return type information from a fetcher.

methods.name: _extract_info
methods.description: Extracts fields and docstring info from fetcher query_params or data models.

methods.name: _get_model
methods.description: Retrieves the model class from a fetcher for query_params or data.

methods.name: _validate
methods.description: Validates that a model is a subclass of the expected parent (QueryParams or Data).

methods.name: _get_class_family
methods.description: Returns the method resolution order (class hierarchy) for a class.
